Rebound Hammer Test Report 37 checkpoints across 6 sections.For quality assessment of in-situ concrete, uniformity evaluation, strength estimation (with caution), identification of weak areas requiring core testing Download ExcelDownload PDF **37** Checkpoints **6** Sections As per design specification or when rapid non-destructive assessment needed QA Inspector, Structural Engineer [IS 516 Part 5 Sec 4:2021](https://infralens.in/code/IS-51654-2021) [IS 13311 Part 2:1992](https://infralens.in/code/IS-133112-1992) Related [📐IS 516 Part 5 Sec 4](https://infralens.in/code/IS-516-Part-5-Sec-4) [✏️Cube Acceptance Criteria M25](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/cube-acceptance-criteria-m25) [📘Concrete Cover Requirements](https://infralens.in/handbook/concrete-cover) [📖Min cover for RCC](https://infralens.in/knowledge/minimum-cover-rcc-is-456) [🔧rcc-design](https://infralens.in/tools/rcc-design) ### Checklist Preview Expand all ↓ | S.No. | Checkpoint | IS Requirement | Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A.
